generator: Blender 5.1 Cycles: the plush snake of blender/snake_scene.py; blender/snake_atlas.py + snake_atlas_pack.py

body.notes: column k is pre-rotated to screen angle k/angles*PI (body axis (cos, sin), y down) and lit by the fixed hero lights; rotate by the residual. The body is seen from its back. Each cell is a window cut from a rendered straight body: |along| <= along*R*(1-(|across|/1.5R)^4)^0.25 with a +-feather*R cross-fade; the fur edge sits at fur_edge_R * R. Straight alpha.

shape.frame: units of R; x forward from the head point; cell image y: jaw toward -y, brow toward +y

head.notes: cell b at column b % cols, row floor(b / cols); head points +x (jaw toward -y), lit for heading th = b/buckets*2PI by the fixed hero lights. Neck fade baked into alpha (x in neck_fade_R). One bead eye baked. No tongue (engine draws it from tongue_base_R). Straight alpha.

cap.notes: round patch of the pink body fur (scale by rc/rc_ref).
